name: Komerce
description: Komerce is an Indonesian tech startup based in Central Java, dedicated to empowering small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) through comprehensive e-commerce solutions. By integrating trained local talent with a suite of digital tools, Komerce enables businesses to streamline operations, from customer service to logistics.
Their platform addresses the challenges faced by SMEs in managing online sales, offering services like marketplace management, warehousing, shipping, and customer relationship management.

list_desc: As Komerce expanded its services to support over 750 SMEs and trained more than 1,300 village youths in e-commerce skills, the need for a centralized system became evident
They required a robust admin dashboard to manage talent assignments, monitor performance, and oversee various operational aspects.
Additionally, integrating tools for order fulfillment, shipping, and customer interactions was crucial to maintain efficiency and scalability.
list_scope: SaaS Platform Development: Developed a scalable, cloud-based platform to support Komerce's growing ecosystem, facilitating seamless integration of various services and tools.
Admin Dashboard: Implemented a comprehensive dashboard allowing administrators to manage talent pools, track performance metrics, and oversee client engagements effectively.
Talent Management System: Created a system to assign trained e-commerce professionals to SMEs based on specific needs, ensuring optimal support for online business operations.

Fulfillment & Logistics Tools: Integrated solutions for warehousing, shipping, and order management, enabling SMEs to handle logistics efficiently within the Komerce platform. By delivering these solutions, we empowered Komerce to enhance its service offerings, streamline operations, and continue its mission of supporting SMEs and local talent in Indonesia.

name: Harwi Gadget
description: Harwi Gadget is a Surabaya-based retailer specializing in the sale of original and high-quality Apple products, including iPads, iPhones, MacBooks, and accessories. They also offer select Android devices. Prior to our collaboration, Harwi Gadget operated primarily through social media platforms and marketplaces, lacking a centralized online presence to showcase their offerings and build brand credibility.

Recognizing the need to establish a professional digital footprint, Harwi Gadget partnered with us to develop a dedicated landing page. This platform aimed to highlight their product range, emphasize their commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, and serve as a conduit for customer inquiries and sales conversions.

list_desc: Brand Credibility: Establish trust with potential customers by presenting a professional and informative website.
Product Showcase: Display their diverse range of products in an organized and visually appealing manner.
Customer Engagement: Provide clear channels for customer inquiries, facilitating seamless communication.
Lead Generation: Drive traffic from social media and marketplaces to their website to increase sales opportunities.
list_scope: Hero Section: Immediate presentation of core offerings and value propositions.
Product Categories: Clear segmentation of products, including iPads, iPhones, MacBooks, Android devices, and accessories.
Testimonials: Showcase of customer feedback to build trust and credibility.
FAQ Section: Addressing common customer queries to streamline the decision-making process.

Contact Information: Multiple channels for customer engagement, including WhatsApp and Instagram links. Post-launch, Harwi Gadget experienced significant business growth, attributed to the enhanced online presence and improved customer engagement facilitated by the new landing page.

name: Kyoo
description: KYOO is a rapidly growing Indonesian startup that provides a digital queuing and appointment platform tailored for businesses across healthcare, government, finance, beauty, and hospitality sectors. Before our involvement, the team had a strong product concept and early traction but needed a more structured and scalable backend system to manage operations, merchant data, appointment flows, and real-time scheduling.
They also needed a centralized interface to give admins and merchants clear visibility and control over booking schedules, queue status, and customer insights.

list_desc: To scale their platform efficiently and enhance the user experience for both internal teams and merchants, KYOO needed a robust admin dashboard system that could handle merchant onboarding, queue and appointment tracking, as well as reporting and feedback management.

A key requirement was the development of a visual calendar interface to manage reservations and appointments across multiple sectors—ranging from clinics to beauty salons. The calendar had to be flexible, real-time, and support both manual inputs and automated scheduling via WhatsApp integration.

Understanding these needs, we delivered a tailored back-office solution that elevated KYOO's operational efficiency, enabled scalable merchant management, and ensured smooth coordination across their multi-industry user base.
list_scope: SaaS Platform Development: Built a scalable, cloud-based SaaS architecture to support KYOO's fast-growing queue and appointment system. The platform was designed to accommodate a diverse set of use cases and industries, with extensible features and modular deployment.

Admin Dashboard: Developed a powerful admin dashboard allowing KYOO's internal team and onboarded merchants to manage customer flow, view appointment analytics, configure business hours, and monitor queue performance in real time.

Calendar View System: Implemented a dynamic, sector-adaptive calendar interface to handle reservations, appointments, and queuing with visual clarity. This feature supports daily, weekly, and monthly views and integrates tightly with WhatsApp notifications, enabling seamless communication between businesses and customers.

name: Game Market
description: GameMarket is a crypto-first digital marketplace where buyers and sellers meet to trade over 10,000+ digital products and services. The platform caters to a global audience of gamers and digital asset enthusiasts, facilitating transactions with various cryptocurrencies.

Recognizing the need for a secure and efficient platform in the burgeoning digital goods market, GameMarket aimed to provide a user-friendly interface that supports crypto payments and ensures the safety of user data and transactions.

list_desc: Crypto Payment Integration: Enable seamless transactions using various cryptocurrencies to cater to a global user base.
User-Friendly Interface: Design an intuitive platform that allows users to easily browse, purchase, and sell digital goods.
Security Compliance: Implement stringent security measures, including penetration testing aligned with ISO standards, to protect user data and transaction integrity.
list_scope: E-commerce Platform Development: Developed a scalable and responsive e-commerce platform tailored for digital goods transactions. The platform supports a wide range of digital products and services, ensuring smooth user experiences for both buyers and sellers.

Crypto Payment Integration: Integrated multiple cryptocurrency payment options, allowing users to conduct transactions using their preferred digital currencies. This feature broadens the platform's appeal to a global audience and aligns with the crypto-first approach.

Security & Penetration Testing: Conducted comprehensive penetration testing in accordance with ISO standards to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities. This process ensured the platform's resilience against cyber threats and reinforced user trust in the security of their transactions and data. Through these implementations, GameMarket successfully launched a secure, user-centric platform that meets the evolving needs of digital goods consumers and sellers in the cryptocurrency space.
